╭─┐help┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮╯│
│        Key:        Description:                                            │─╯
│        F2, o       Shows options.                                          │─╮
│      F1, ?, h      Shows this window.                                      │%│
│      ctrl + r      Reloads config file from disk.                          │8│
│     q, ctrl + c    Quits program.                                          │0│
│       +, -, =      Add/Subtract 100ms to/from update timer.                │6│
│      Up, Down      Select in process list.                                 │5│
│        Enter       Show detailed information for selected process.         │9│
│      Spacebar      Expand/collapse the selected process in tree view.      │2│
│          C         Expand/collapse the selected process' children.         │6│
│   Pg Up, Pg Down   Jump 1 page in process list.                            │6│
│      Home, End     Jump to first or last page in process list.             │ │
│     Left, Right    Select previous/next sorting column.                    │ │
│        b, n        Select previous/next network device.                    │ │
│          i         Toggle disks io mode with big graphs.                   │ │
│          z         Toggle totals reset for current network device          │ │
